generation.scope: At any reduced point of a finite Frobenius point graph, the entire four-tensor has a canonical traceless presentation by four triples of three-by-three matrices. Both adjacent rank-six conditions reduce to one commutator equation linear in two of the triples. All marked basis changes, the opposite rank and the common-plane condition at rank eight are explicit. The complete kernel of point evaluation has a three-letter presentation by eight cubic commutators per position, with no higher defining relations.

open_mathematics: Use the rank drop of the opposite two-point contraction on a smooth nondegenerate curve to obtain a degree-(2,2) divisor on its square and restrictions on the canonical monodromy; also solve remaining matrix commutator branches for finite graphs.
